title: Skeletá
studio_context: Mixed by Andy Wallace and Dan Malsch; the band's first Billboard 200 number one.

drum_performances.name: The Nameless Ghoul on drums
drum_performances.why_it_matters: Satanized in 12/8 with the hats opening on the beats; Lachryma's open-hat quarters. The studio drums are credited to a session player, not to the ghoul (the credit's name is not stored: the drummer's chair is private); the record stands for the parts the drumming ghoul plays live.
